verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party interactive API reference with runnable examples for Adyen In-Person Payments. Adyen publishes OpenAPI definition files on GitHub and suggests loading them into third-party tools (Swagger Editor, SwaggerHub, Postman). That is a developer building block plus a user-side workaround, so it earns no credit. The probe also found no hosted OpenAPI endpoint on docs.adyen.com.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: This repository contains Adyen API definition files, represented in the OpenAPI Specification standard
If you prefer to use the classic Swagger toolset, upload these definitions to the [Swagger Editor](http://editor.swagger.io/) or [SwaggerHub](https://swaggerhub.com/).
we recommend you use [Postman](https://www.getpostman.com/postman) to import the API definition and create your personal collection of requests.
